findings.headline: Judges missed malformed tool arguments in 37.2%–64.4% of agent trajectories (best detection 62.8%, 95% CI [55.6, 69.4])
findings.why: A failure class output-only evaluation cannot reach by construction.

findings.headline: The weakest judge reversed its verdict on 32.3% of comparisons purely because the two options were swapped; showing the reference first over-reports accuracy by up to 12.1 points
findings.why: The number a fixed-order harness reports is inflated by a bias it did not control.

findings.headline: The best judge ranks at 95.4% but classifies at 80.0% at its own rubric's cut-off — moving the threshold recovers 94.0%
findings.why: Ranking well and deciding well are different properties, measured differently.

teacher_accuracy.caveat: tuned on the same labels it is scored against; an upper bound, not a fair comparison
